01-intro: A colleague from the sales team, a man in his mid thirties, stands with a Power Platform maker, a woman in her early thirties, among green plants in a bright open-plan sales office, both in modern work-casual clothes; he holds open the team's approved playbook for answering customer objections, a slim binder with a plain pastel cover whose pages show only pastel colour blocks and faint grey lines, with no letters, words or numbers anywhere, and points at one page as he explains how the team answers an objection, while she listens with a coffee cup in hand and both smile.
02-cowork: The regional manager for Northern Europe at a Nordic outdoor-gear retailer, a woman in her early thirties in modern work-casual clothes, stands on the bright sales floor of the company's newly refitted flagship store and holds up a mid-layer fleece in a muted pastel colour, checking the fit of its sleeve with a relaxed smile; behind her, softly out of focus, light-oak tables carry neat stacks of folded fleeces with plain tags, green plants between them.
03-cs-basics: A Power Platform maker in her early thirties and a colleague from HR in his late twenties stand at a light-oak high table in a bright HR office; she turns her plain laptop with no logo on its lid toward him so its screen faces the camera, showing a softly blurred chat panel with light-blue bubbles, while he holds one plain sheet of paper covered only in faint grey lines, with no heading, title, letters, words or numbers anywhere, and both smile.
04-cs-tools: Two IT help desk technicians of a logistics company, a woman and a man in their early thirties in modern work-casual clothes, unpack a supplier's delivery of new hardware at a long light-oak bench in a bright help desk room; she lifts a plain grey wireless headset out of a plain unprinted cardboard box and shows it to him, he holds a small plain docking station, more headsets and docking stations stand lined up in neat rows on the bench beside a green plant, and both smile.
05-cs-advanced: Two colleagues of the same company, a woman and a man in their early thirties in modern work-casual clothes with small carry-on suitcases, chat and smile on a bright, modern glass-roofed train platform in Vienna before their business trip to Budapest, the platform is completely free of signs, boards, clocks and lettering of any kind.
06-cs-gh-copilot: At a light-oak table in the bright, modern dining room of a bistro customer before service, an Aurora Provisions sales rep in her early thirties in modern work-casual clothes sets out a customer tasting: small white dishes of aged balsamic, smoked paprika and saffron threads beside plain jars and a small bottle with blank kraft labels; the customer, a man in his late thirties, dips a piece of bread into the aged balsamic and both smile, the empty dining room softly blurred behind them.
07-cs-maintaining: A Power Platform maker in her early thirties and a colleague from the Grey Logistics IT help desk team, a man in his late twenties, both in modern work-casual clothes, stand side by side at a tall window in the bright Grey Logistics office; she holds a closed plain laptop with no logo on its lid under one arm, and both laugh as he gives a thumbs up because their help desk agent has just gone live for every employee.
08-ai-teammates: At the quarterly supplier review, a procurement colleague in her early thirties in modern work-casual clothes welcomes a supplier executive in his late thirties with a handshake in a bright lobby with light-oak benches and green plants; she holds the supplier's scorecard in a slim folder with a plain cover under her arm, and both smile as they walk on together; the walls and doors carry no signs, plaques or lettering of any kind.
